registered: 2026-10-08 after initial coverage study; a numerical/inference challenger, not a replacement coverage experiment
method: Parametric trajectory bootstrap plus independent conditional emission-calibration bootstrap, holding observed calibration labels fixed; refit complete joint model
report: All fit failures; bootstrap standard deviation, percentile and basic interval endpoints only when fewer than 5% failures; step-size and multistart objective sensitivity
scope: One predetermined dataset numerical challenger. 199 refits do not establish repeated-sample coverage or accurate tail endpoints.
